August 29 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 340)

This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on August 29 across American network radio and BBC Radio 4, Jack Webb starring as jazz cornetist Pete Kelly in Kansas City speakeasy battles on Pete Kelly's Blues (1951), Edward R. Murrow's live eyewitness reports during London's longest air raid on The World Today (1940), June Whitfield starring as Agatha Christie's Miss Marple on BBC Air Castle, Irna Phillips' The Guiding Light for Duz, and Meet the Press interviews (1940–1998):
